title: A query without the shard key has to ask every shard
caption: The query is as slow as the slowest shard and fails if any one shard fails. More shards make it worse, not better.

messages.label: WHERE user_id = 'kim'
messages.note: The shard key is in the query: the router sends it to one shard.

messages.label: WHERE email = 'k@x.io'
messages.note: Sharded by user_id, but this filters on email. The router can't know which shard holds it.

messages.label: search
messages.note: It fans out to all N shards in parallel.

messages.label: slowest reply · 40 ms
messages.note: The answer waits for the slowest shard (tail latency), then the router merges the results.

messages.label: merged result
messages.note: Fix: a global secondary index email → user_id, itself sharded by email, so the lookup becomes two single-shard reads.
